name: Contact Attributes 5
definition: Communication device number or address used for communication.

EmailAddress.name: Email Address
EmailAddress.definition: Address for electronic mail (e-mail) for the party.

URLAddress.name: URL Address
URLAddress.definition: Address for the Universal Resource Locator (URL), for example, used over the www (HTTP) service.

AnyBIC.name: Any BIC
AnyBIC.definition: Identification of the party expressed as a BIC.

LEI.name: LEI
LEI.definition: Legal entity identification as an alternate identification for the party.
